history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: this Shiva shrine is documented only as a Meta/Facebook places listing ('Pathaleshwar temple', near basar, Mudhol, TS, IN), ~966 m (3171 ft) from Basara. No published history, hours, or festivals were found. Coordinates (18.885289, 77.95274) are the listing's exact location, NOT from map.geocode. Treat as a thin provisional record; CSV town Basara is correct (within ~1 km).

name: Pathaleshwara Temple (Basara)
town_description: Basara (Basar) is a census town in Nirmal district, Telangana, on the banks of the Godavari river, about 35 km from Nizamabad. It is a major pilgrimage town centred on the Gnana Saraswathi temple; several small shrines lie in and around it.
